Mid-to-senior Go backend developer role (roughly 5–7 years of experience) at Rare Candy, working on the backend of an AI-powered trading-card collector platform and marketplace. The work involves building and maintaining backend services and GraphQL APIs alongside mobile and frontend engineers, designing relational data models, and implementing business logic, background jobs, and third-party integrations for collections and marketplace features. The core stack is Go, GraphQL, and SQL with relational databases, plus automated testing and log- and metrics-based debugging in production.
